name: feedback-analyzer
description: Analyze feedback and feature requests into evidence-linked themes, needs, and prioritization options.

interface.longDescription: Analyze customer comments, support notes, interviews, surveys, and feature requests. Organize themes, uncover underlying needs, identify duplicate or conflicting requests, compare segments, and create transparent prioritization options linked to evidence and business goals. Recommendations support human product judgment; they do not decide the roadmap.
defaultPrompt: Cluster this customer feedback by theme and underlying user need, with counts and evidence.
Deduplicate and prioritize these feature requests using my stated goals and constraints.
Compare feedback themes across customer segments and identify conflicting needs.
